name: Natsuki And Chill
storyline:
Set in a quiet suburban town, Natsuki and Chill follows the story of Natsuki, a sharp-tongued but secretly tender-hearted girl who spends most of her time writing poetry and baking sweets. After school one day, she invites the protagonist over to "chill"—but what starts as a simple afternoon of reading manga and making cupcakes slowly turns into something more meaningful.

As they spend time together, the layers of Natsuki’s personality begin to unravel. Beneath her tsundere attitude lies a girl craving warmth, understanding, and safety from the pressures of a broken home. Through shared laughter, small confessions, and quiet moments, the player helps Natsuki open up and find comfort in vulnerability.

Natsuki and Chill is a slice-of-life visual experience about emotional healing, companionship, and the unexpected depth behind a simple invitation to “chill.”
summary: After telling her that you're interested in her, Natsuki wants to come to your place! Spend a chill evening with her... And maybe get a little more intimate...
